# Project conventions

- This is a small client-side SPA.
- Use vanilla JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
- Do not introduce frameworks, TypeScript, build tools, or dependencies unless asked.
- Prefer simple browser APIs over abstractions.
- Preserve existing naming and structure unless refactoring is explicitly requested.
- Make the smallest change that satisfies the request.
- Do not modify unrelated code.
- Ask before introducing a new architectural pattern.
